_note: Phase 400 plan 11 (AX-01, AX-02). level_wording: the Well-defined test of the definition level. v1 is the shipped default and equals the Well-defined signal cell of the Axis 1 table in references/methodology/problem-types.md. v2 is the reworded test of F-07 and O-02 (a stated, measurable target makes a problem Well-defined, and also wicked when the target is disputed and fixes shift it); it is provisional because F-07 measured it on the same cases it was fitted on, so it ships only behind MINDRIAN_LEVEL_WORDING=v2. wicked_cutoff: F-06 found the raw wicked answer says yes too readily at 0.5, so a wicked probability becomes yes or no only through a stored fitted cut-off; scripts/derive-wicked-cutoff.cjs fits it at dev time and writes only the value, counts and file hashes. Local data only: no level or wicked question is sent anywhere (Canon Part 8).

v2.well_defined: A specific measurable target, or a closed set of known options with known measures. This holds even when the parties dispute it. A general wish to improve does not count.
v2.wicked_note: A well-defined problem can also be wicked: when the target is disputed and each fix shifts the problem.
v2.basis: F-07, fitted on the same cases; fresh cases deferred

wicked_cutoff.rule: a wicked probability becomes yes only at or above a stored cut-off: fitted from labels, or ruled by the owner and provisional until a fit replaces it; with no stored cut-off the answer is unknown (null); never a raw 0.5 cut (F-06)

ruled_on.method: provisional conservative policy choice; a false yes is weighted worse because the wicked label changes the posture of the product (F-06); not fitted from labels
ruled_on.decided_by: Codex and Fable 5.2, delegated by the owner
